statement.text:
Is there a positive integer n such that the hypercenter of any finite soluble
group coincides with the intersection of n system normalizers of that group? What is
the least number with this property?
   Comment of 2017: This is proved for groups with trivial Frattini subgroup
(A. Ballester-Bolinches, J. Cossey, S. F. Kamornikov, H. Meng, J. Algebra, 499 (2018),
438–449).                                              A. F. Vasil’ev, L. A. Shemetkov
